done_when: With another host holding the Pipeliner lease, a Lead session that loaded pipeline mode ships a card-only commit with sync.py ship; desk.py post/take/done still refuse; a fail-first test covers both; ROLES/lead pipeline.md states the rule.
goal: A Lead session that loaded pipeline mode only to look at the desk cannot ship cards or docs while another machine holds the Pipeliner lease (2026-10-26: 6 commits stuck up to 45 min). The lease should guard desk, claim and queue writes only; cards and docs ship without it.

note: OPERATOR QUOTE: is this an limitation or part of the design? what is a better solution if this is an overhead? File a bug for this on priority.
scope_out: live tree; the lease file format used by other machines
steps: read lease.py:22-30 and :435 and sync.py ship guard; list which commands call the guard
limit the guard to desk/claim/queue writes; ship of non-queue paths passes; or add 'lease.py unload' to drop the Pipeliner role for the session
fail-first tests: ship with foreign lease passes for a cards-only diff, desk post refuses
note in pipeline.md: load pipeline mode only when draining the desk
